json_ld_descriptions:
At Paulson Coletti Trial Attorneys PC, "liberty and justice for all" is more than just a phrase – it is our mandate. Our team of lawyers is driven to pursue justice for the injured, ensuring that the responsible parties are held accountable. With a high success rate both in and out of the courtroom, you can trust our Oregon and Washington state personal injury attorneys to be the legal advocates you need so your voice can be heard.

We are a boutique Oregon and Washington personal injury law firm that excels in representing those harmed due to negligence. Our mission is to achieve justice for victims of serious injury and hold the liable parties accountable. We focus our efforts on aggressively pursuing the maximum possible in economic and non-economic damages, either in a negotiated settlement or in civil court.
